components.name: Cemu
components.requiredFor: Running the game (one Cemu per player)
components.verified: Official Cemu release page; URL answers 200 and the hash is that of the file the working install was built from.

components.name: Milk Bar Launcher
components.requiredFor: Online mode (the multiplayer mod and the dedicated server). Never bundled: always downloaded from its upstream release.
components.verified: Upstream GitHub release asset; URL answers 200 and the size matches. The release publishes no digest, so the hash is that of the file the working install was built from.

components.name: Cemu graphic packs
components.requiredFor: Extended Memory (needed by the multiplayer mod) and FPS++
components.verified: Official cemu-project release; the hash was computed from the downloaded file when this manifest was written (the release publishes no digest). The two marker files match the working install byte for byte.

components.name: Python
components.requiredFor: BCML, which merges the multiplayer mod. Installed per user into the project folder: no PATH changes, no Store Python.
components.verified: Official python.org download; URL answers 200 and the hash is that of the file the working install was built from.

components.name: BCML
components.requiredFor: Merging the multiplayer mod into the game
components.verified: Every wheel is pinned by SHA-256 in the requirements file (taken from the pypi.org JSON API). The pip install itself has not been run end to end.
